```{r}
library(abcdutils)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)

core_path <- path_maker(here("local-data/abcd/core"))
import <- function(path) {
    return(abcd_load(core_path(path)))
}
proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("local-data/abcd/results/processed")))

mtbi_ful_df <- readRDS(proc_path("2025_09_16_mtbi_ful_df.rds"))

colnames(mtbi_ful_df)

mtbi_ful_df$sex

ph_y_anthro <- import("physical-health/ph_y_anthro.csv")

anthro_data <- ph_y_anthro |>
    filter_timepoint(0) |>
    dplyr::select(
        subjectkey,
        anthroheightcalc,
        anthroweightcalc
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        uid = paste0("uid_", subjectkey),
        bmi = anthroweightcalc * 703 / (anthroheightcalc * anthroheightcalc)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(-subjectkey) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(mtbi_ful_df, by = "uid")

anthro_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = bmi)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20)) +
    labs(x = "Subtype", y = "BMI")

summary(aov(bmi ~ cluster, data = anthro_data))

TukeyHSD(aov(bmi ~ cluster + age, data = anthro_data))

summary(lm(bmi ~ age + race + sex + cluster, data = anthro_data))
```
